package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

func (store TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository) EnsurePending(ctx context.Context, candidate domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(candidate)
	if store.Pool == nil || err != nil || normalized.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	tx, err := store.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	if err = lockOnboardingDialog(ctx, tx, normalized.DialogID); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	existing, found, err := scanOptionalTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(tx.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns+` WHERE student_id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, normalized.StudentID))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	if found {
		if !sameTeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionIdentity(existing, normalized) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	interaction, interactionFound, err := scanOptionalTeacherOnboardingInteraction(tx.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingInteractionColumns+`
WHERE dialog_id=$1 AND personal_teacher_id=$2 AND state IN ('active','reserved')
ORDER BY interaction_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
`, normalized.DialogID, normalized.PersonalTeacherID))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	if interactionFound {
		if interaction.StudentID != normalized.StudentID || interaction.SessionSchemaVersion != 3 {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
		}
		var actionPending bool
		if err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
 WHERE student_id=$1 AND dialog_id=$2 AND personal_teacher_id=$3
   AND source_message_id=$4 AND source_message_version=$5
   AND status IN ('claimed','applied','materialized'))
`, normalized.StudentID, normalized.DialogID, normalized.PersonalTeacherID, interaction.PromptMessageID, interaction.PromptMessageVersion).Scan(&actionPending); err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
		}
		if actionPending {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
		}
		closed, closeErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_interaction SET state='closed',closed_reason='active_path_exists',closed_at=$2,updated_at=$2 WHERE interaction_id=$1 AND state='active'`, interaction.ID, normalized.CreatedAt)
		if closeErr != nil || closed.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			if closeErr != nil {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, closeErr
			}
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
	}
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_onboarding_terminal_session (
 terminal_session_id,student_id,personal_teacher_id,dialog_id,session_schema_version,state_ref_kind,state_ref_version,
 terminal_kind,terminal_message_command_id,status,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,'message_pending',$10,$10)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
`, normalized.ID, normalized.StudentID, normalized.PersonalTeacherID, normalized.DialogID, normalized.SessionSchemaVersion,
		normalized.StateRef.Kind, normalized.StateRef.Version, normalized.TerminalKind, normalized.TerminalMessageCommandID, normalized.CreatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	stored, err := scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(tx.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns+` WHERE student_id=$1`, normalized.StudentID))
	if err != nil || !sameTeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionIdentity(stored, normalized) {
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	return stored, command.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository) FindOnlyRecoverableForStudent(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(studentID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns+` WHERE student_id=$1 ORDER BY terminal_session_id LIMIT 2`, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var record domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession
	count := 0
	for rows.Next() {
		record, err = scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
		}
		count++
	}
	if err = rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, err
	}
	if count > 1 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	return record, count == 1, nil
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository) MarkDelivered(ctx context.Context, id, dialogMessageID string, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(id) || !validUUIDString(dialogMessageID) || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	existing, err := scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns+` WHERE terminal_session_id=$1`, id))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, err
	}
	if existing.Status == domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalDelivered {
		if existing.DialogMessageID != dialogMessageID {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		return existing, nil
	}
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_terminal_session SET status='delivered',dialog_message_id=$2,delivered_at=$3,updated_at=$3 WHERE terminal_session_id=$1 AND status='message_pending'`, id, dialogMessageID, now.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		stored, readErr := scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns+` WHERE terminal_session_id=$1`, id))
		if readErr == nil && stored.Status == domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalDelivered && stored.DialogMessageID == dialogMessageID {
			return stored, nil
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, readErr
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns+` WHERE terminal_session_id=$1`, id))
}

const teacherOnboardingTerminalSessionColumns = `SELECT
terminal_session_id::text,student_id,personal_teacher_id::text,dialog_id::text,session_schema_version,
state_ref_kind,state_ref_version,terminal_kind,terminal_message_command_id::text,status,dialog_message_id::text,
created_at,updated_at,delivered_at
FROM teacher_onboarding_terminal_session`

func scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(row teacherOnboardingRow) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, error) {
	var record domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession
	var dialogMessageID *string
	var deliveredAt *time.Time
	err := row.Scan(&record.ID, &record.StudentID, &record.PersonalTeacherID, &record.DialogID, &record.SessionSchemaVersion,
		&record.StateRef.Kind, &record.StateRef.Version, &record.TerminalKind, &record.TerminalMessageCommandID, &record.Status,
		&dialogMessageID, &record.CreatedAt, &record.UpdatedAt, &deliveredAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, err
	}
	record.DialogMessageID = valueOrEmpty(dialogMessageID)
	record.DeliveredAt = timeOrZero(deliveredAt)
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(record)
}

func scanOptionalTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(row teacherOnboardingRow) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error) {
	record, err := scanTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(row)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, false, nil
	}
	return record, err == nil, err
}

func sameTeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionIdentity(left, right domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) bool {
	return left.ID == right.ID && left.StudentID == right.StudentID && left.PersonalTeacherID == right.PersonalTeacherID &&
		left.DialogID == right.DialogID && left.SessionSchemaVersion == right.SessionSchemaVersion && left.StateRef == right.StateRef &&
		left.TerminalKind == right.TerminalKind && left.TerminalMessageCommandID == right.TerminalMessageCommandID
}
